input.bodyText:
Beta player messages – what we say to players (Oct 1, 2025)

Retention we're judged on: Sep 15 install week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION, Zombie Match 3D)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day (NotificationManager, rescheduled every time the app closes, so "day" means days since the last session)
- Day 1: Lapsed 1 day, "The Horde Is Growing… 🧟‍♂️". Go.
- Days 2–6: nothing.
- Day 7: Lapsed 7 days. Go, with the headline changing to "Your Squad Needs You Back" (DES-346). The client still ships "They’ve Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱" until that string lands.
- Days 14, 21, 28: the same Lapsed 7 days message again (weekly batch of 4). This already covers the 14-day ask, so DES-344 is a Drop.
- Day 3 and day 30: not scheduled. Both asks (DES-342, DES-343) are Hold on test 3.
- Nothing after day 28.
Only players who have been through our own permission ask (after level 20) get any of these. The settings toggle doesn't count and neither does the iOS launch popup.

Already scheduled by the client but still a Hold, and why
- Lives recharged (DES-315), test 6: Vincent took his tick off. On iOS 0.3.49 it didn't arrive after a full refill (tried twice).
- Finish first mission (DES-318), test 4: it targets players below level 20, but our permission ask only runs after level 20, so none of them count. It only arrived for Vincent with the settings toggle on.
- Plague Race start (DES-319), test 6: the iOS pass was on the 5-minute-timer build. On the real 0.3.40 it never showed. Android is fine.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320), test 5: it fires 7/14/21/28 days after the app last closed, not on the server's weekly reset day.

Totals across all 32 messages (14 sheet rows + 18 asks): 2 Go, 24 Hold, 6 Drop. The Go list is on the Push Notifications card for Vincent. The full per-message sheet is "Beta player messages – calls (Oct 1)" in this folder. Held tickets go to Backlog, unassigned, per the BETA card.

• *Go:* Lapsed 1 day and Lapsed 7 days. Lapsed 7 gets your "Your Squad Needs You Back" headline; the string ticket is DES-346. Both are on a checklist on the Push Notifications card for Vincent.
• *Drop:* Hourly Coins, Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever and Axe Arena (not in the beta), Lapsed 14 days (already covered by the Lapsed 7 days batch on day 14), Comeback gift (v2).
